title: 挑战 4 · 拨动开关选红灯 / 绿灯
summary: SPDT 开关拨到一边亮红灯，拨到另一边亮绿灯。
concepts: SPDT switch 单刀双掷开关
description:
单刀双掷（SPDT）拨动开关有 3 只脚：中间的 com 是公共端，拨杆在 a 侧时 com 接 a，在 b 侧时 com 接 b。

要求：+5V 接开关的 com；a 脚 → 220Ω → 红色 LED → GND；b 脚 → 220Ω → 绿色 LED → GND。
• 拨到 a：红灯亮、绿灯灭；
• 拨到 b：绿灯亮、红灯灭。

请把红灯接在 a 侧（开关最左边那只脚），绿灯接在 b 侧（最右边那只脚）。

en.title: Challenge 4 · Slide switch picks red / green
en.summary: Flip the SPDT switch one way for the red LED and the other way for the green LED.
en.description:
A single-pole double-throw (SPDT) slide switch has 3 pins: the middle one, com, is the common terminal. With the lever on the a side, com connects to a; on the b side, com connects to b.

Task: +5V to the switch's com; pin a → 220Ω → red LED → GND; pin b → 220Ω → green LED → GND.
• Flipped to a: red on, green off;
• Flipped to b: green on, red off.

Connect the red LED on the a side (the switch's leftmost pin) and the green LED on the b side (the rightmost pin).
hints: The switch's three pins take up three neighbouring columns: a on the left, com in the middle, b on the right.
+5V must go to the middle column (com).
Both LED cathodes go back to the blue GND rail.
tests: Flipped to a: red on, green off
Flipped to b: green on, red off

hints: 开关三只脚占三个相邻的列：左 a、中 com、右 b。
两个 LED 的负极都回到 GND 蓝轨。
